content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is it possible to connect a PT100 temperature sensor directly to [product_name] [version_no]?
No, a direct connection is not feasible. You will need either an [product_name] analog module or an external PT100 converter that outputs in the range of 0-10V or 0/4-20 mA.

analysis.insight_summary: One user asks about connecting a PT100 temperature sensor directly to [product_name] [version_no]. Other users clarify that this can't be done without extra hardware, such as a specific analog module or external converter. This requirement adds complexity and may limit straightforward use of temperature sensors with the system.
